title: GEMI: caller tools return as OpenAI tool_calls; max_tokens reaches the engine
goal: CEO direction 2026-11-12 ("Fix gemi completely"), defects 4 and 5 of board item 229 (T-CODEXHISTORY-1 had meanwhile carried the conversation and tool schemas to the engine). (a) A request with its own `tools`: the model's call came back as raw `<tool_call>` text, or, streamed, core ran it against its own tool registry (`[SUSI TOOLS] get_weather is not a registered tool — skipped`) and the call was lost. GEMI now returns calls to caller-supplied tools behind `plane_bus::gemi::CALLER_TOOL_CALLS` instead of executing them, and the 9091 server turns them into OpenAI `tool_calls` (`content: null` when there is no text, `finish_reason: "tool_calls"`; streamed as a `tool_calls` delta). (b) `max_tokens` is added to the conversation sent to the local engine, so the engine stops there instead of generating its configured 512 tokens for the server to trim.

results.live: Isolated daemon in a private network namespace, commercial plug host with T-CLAUDECOMMMAXTOK-1, starter model. Request with tools=[get_weather] 'What is the weather in Paris right now?': finish_reason tool_calls, content null, tool_calls [{type function, name get_weather, arguments {"city":"Paris"}}] (before: raw <tool_call> text). Same request streamed: a tool_calls delta then finish_reason tool_calls (before: '[SUSI TOOLS] `get_weather` is not a registered tool — skipped'). The tool result fed back: 'The current weather in Paris is described as a light rain with a temperature of 9 degrees Celsius.' max_tokens 5: 2.1 s (before: 52.2 s).

limitations: The engine reports no token count, so a reply the engine cut at max_tokens still says finish_reason stop unless the server's own estimate also cut it.
Cloud and external providers still receive the assembled prose and no tool schemas (T-CODEXHISTORY-1's limitation), so caller tools work on the local engine path only.
Anthropic /v1/messages does not translate tool_use blocks.
A 0.5B model ignored a system instruction to answer in French; the instruction reaches the engine (T-CODEXHISTORY-1), so this is the model's limit.
